actors.name: Brightline Software Account Manager
actors.private_context: The account manager is preparing for a scheduled retention call with Fenwick & Sloane. They know Fenwick & Sloane has expressed intent to cancel their subscription. The manager's goal is to persuade them to pause instead. They have prepared talking points about the benefits of pausing and potential future discounts.

actors.name: Fenwick & Sloane Representative
actors.private_context: The representative is the decision-maker for the subscription. They have been considering cancellation due to budget constraints and perceived lack of use. They are open to hearing options but are leaning toward cancellation. They have authority to decide on pausing or canceling.

shared_context: Brightline Software provides a subscription service to Fenwick & Sloane. A retention call is scheduled for this week (the week of 2026-09-08). The call will discuss the subscription status. Fenwick & Sloane has indicated they want to cancel, but Brightline hopes to offer a pause as an alternative.

starting_events.description: The scheduled retention call between Brightline Software's account manager and Fenwick & Sloane's representative is about to begin.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that during the call, Fenwick & Sloane's representative explicitly agrees to pause (rather than cancel) their subscription before the call ends. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
